title: Zechariah Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Zechariah 3: Joshua before the angel, the filthy garments and the clean turban, and the stone with seven eyes.

questions.text: Who was shown standing before Yahweh's angel?
questions.explanation: He showed him Joshua the high priest standing before Yahweh's angel.

questions.text: Who stood at his right hand to be his adversary?
questions.explanation: Satan stood at Joshua's right hand to be his adversary.

answers.text: A man with a measuring line

questions.text: Which image does Yahweh use in the question he asks as he rebukes Satan?
questions.explanation: As he rebukes Satan, Yahweh asks, "Isn't this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?"

answers.text: A lamp that has run out of oil
A burning stick plucked out of the fire
A vine that bears no fruit at all
A stone set in the wall of a house

questions.text: What was Joshua wearing as he stood before the angel?
questions.explanation: Joshua was clothed with filthy garments and was standing before the angel.

questions.text: What was said to him when the filthy garments were taken off?
questions.explanation: He was told, "Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing."

answers.text: That he would be sent to Babylon
That his iniquity had passed from him
That he would see the Branch
That he must leave the courts

questions.text: What was set on Joshua's head?
questions.explanation: He said, "Let them set a clean turban on his head," and they set a clean turban on his head and clothed him.

questions.text: What is promised if Joshua will walk in Yahweh's ways and follow his instructions?
questions.explanation: Then he will also judge Yahweh's house and keep his courts, and be given a place of access among those who stand by.

answers.text: He will judge the house and keep the courts
He will reign over the nations
He will build the walls of the city
He will live for many years

questions.text: Whom does Yahweh of Armies say he will bring out?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch."

questions.text: What is on the one stone that Yahweh has set before Joshua?
questions.explanation: On that one stone are seven eyes, and Yahweh says he will engrave its engraving and remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

questions.text: What will every man do in that day, according to the last verse?
questions.explanation: In that day each one will invite his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.

answers.text: Bring an offering to the temple in Jerusalem
Return to his own land from the nations
Invite his neighbor under the vine and the fig tree
Keep silence before Yahweh in his holy house
